description: List the cosmetic products on INKEEDecoder (formerly INCIDecoder) that contain a given ingredient — the reverse of a product page. Optionally include the products that declare the ingredient's percentage. Returns one page at a time. Read-only.

id.description: Ingredient slug, site path (/ingredients/...), or ingredient URL on inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com.

include_known_amount.description: Include the "products with a known amount" carousel (products that declare the percentage). Only present on page 1. Default false.

page.description: 1-based page number. Each response states whether another page is available.

name: inkeedecoder_get_ingredient_products

knownAmountProducts.description: Products that declare the ingredient's percentage, when `include_known_amount` was set on page 1.

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

title: Get products containing an ingredient
